fix.item: Improved integration access checks and fallback metadata handling.
Fixed resource preload attributes and improved Open Graph metadata validation.

change.item: Replaced deprecated plugin event calls with Joomla's event dispatcher.
Refactored metadata and Facebook helper classes.
Updated Firebase to 13.3.0 and Workbox to 7.4.1.
Updated PHP and JavaScript dependencies and rebuilt JavaScript and CSS bundles.

new.item: Added Capacitor integration for native applications, including JavaScript module loading and plugin settings.
Added native push notification support for iOS and Android.
Added Capacitor integrations for the status bar, splash screen, app updates and in-app reviews.
Added device and browser detection for push notifications and stored device data with push subscriptions.
Added a link to notification settings within the iPhone app.

fix.item: Improved native iOS push token retrieval by waiting for the token API to become available and handling temporary failures.
Fixed in-app review initialization and changed review requests to run on click.

change.item: Removed web push notification control buttons from native Capacitor applications.
Removed script and stylesheet prefetching and added preloading for the Capacitor integration module.
Optimized Capacitor imports and refactored integration code.
Updated localization for Capacitor modules and removed unused language constants.
Updated Composer and JavaScript dependencies, including fixes for vulnerable Node.js dependencies, and rebuilt JavaScript and CSS bundles.
